## Description

A desmid of two symmetrical warty semicells (56–111 × 48–85 µm) joined by an isthmus, with two
pyrenoids per semicell. On dividing, each daughter keeps one semicell and builds the other.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 3 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

The deep, narrow sinus on each side of the isthmus is a body [notch](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md) (a bit
wider than the real one: a narrower sinus crosses itself when dividing). After division the new
semicell [sprouts from the isthmus](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md) and expands over a few hours.

## Literature

- Kreutz M., realmicrolife.com (size, pyrenoids, sinus).
- Meindl U. (1993) *Micrasterias* cells as a model system for research on morphogenesis. Microbiol.
  Rev. 57: 415–433 (semicell expansion; time estimated).

## Unique and shared mechanics

Shares [semicell regrowth](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md) with *Micrasterias*; the notch mechanism with
*Colpoda*, *Paramecium* and *Micrasterias*.
